occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: The caregiver's record was available for reivew and was missing the followng documents:    1. Documentation showing how the employee meets the minimum age and education qualifications, and     2. A Pre-Employment Affidavit for Applicants for Employment at Certain Child Care Operations (Form 2912).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver was missing 8 clock hours of annual training for training year 9/9/2024-9/8/2025. A second caregiver was missing 6 clock hours of annual training for training year 11/12/2024 - 11/11/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was caring for 5 infants in the infant room. The ages of the children were a 2 month old, two infants 5 months old, a 9 month old, and a 14 month old. The specified age of the children in the group is 0-11 months.  According to the ratio chart the maximum number of children one caregiver may supervise is 4.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director was missing 23 of 30 clock hours of annual training for training year 10/1/2024 - 9/30/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A caregiver was caring for 11 children of varying ages including infants in the outdoor playground. There was more than an 18 month age difference between the oldest and youngest child in the group. The youngest child in the group was 2 months old and the oldest child was 4 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director was missing 30 clock hours of annual training for training year 10/1/2024 - 9/30/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: There was no record available for review for a caregiver caring for a group of children in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: A caregiver caring for a group of children in the infant room was missing 24 clock hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 2 of 4 children's records reviewed were missing the child's immunization records.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver was missing 15 clock hours of annual training for training year 9/9/2024-9/8/2025. A second caregiver was missing 13 clock hours of annual training for training year 11/12/2024 - 11/11/2025.

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat located in the pre-k room was covered with a type of material that was absorbent and hard to sanitize.
